messages:
emily_p: heads up — customers hit confusing behavior when saving route views that include per-model pins. they expect the saved view to restore model pins but our save currently drops them. repro attached.

mike_s: is this the same as the model-pin attr we keep in runtime? atm we strip pins to avoid stale references, which is why restore reverts to default model.

emily_p: yep. that breaks canary rollouts: apps get served older models unexpectedly and telemetry attribution is messy.

dave_research: idea: store pins as immutable model_ref ids + timestamp, and on restore try exact match then fallback to a 'latest-compatible' strategy. also record fallback reason.

jen_console: from UX — users want visibility. show a badge on a saved view: `Saved with model pins (vX)` and in restore modal show a toggle `Use latest models instead` with an explanation.

mike_s: backend sketch: `POST /api/savedviews { name, filters, scope: 'route'|'model', pins: [{model_id, pinned_version}] }`. we can accept pins but must validate on apply.

alex_ops: telemetry needs: `saved_view.apply` events with fields `resolve_strategy`, `pin_fallback` (bool), `original_model_id`, `resolved_model_id`. want to be able to query fallback rates by saved view id.

sam_platform: also quota/cost note — applying a saved view that pins heavy models (LLMs) across many routes/orgs can spike token burn. UI should show a `preview_cost_estimate` and server should throttle bulk applies.

emily_p: preview cost is a must. design wants an inline hint near the Apply button: small estimate + a warning if it exceeds org quota.

jen_console: mockups: https://figma.com/s/abc123 — compact chip: `cost ~1.2k tokens` and color-coded if >10% org-monthly. fallback option appears if pinned models unavailable.

mike_s: implementation plan: augment save endpoint to compute and persist a static `cost_estimate` (based on sample traffic), and add server-side guard `apply_count_per_minute` + `cost_budget_check`.

dave_research: also emit `apply_latency` histogram and `fallback_rate` metric per saved_view so we can alert during rollouts and measure UX regressions.

alex_ops: +1. add tracing hook so we can map saved view apply -> routing policy (dedicated/dynamic/fallback) for debugging.

sam_platform: who owns the API/telemetry spec? I can draft the proto and the API contract.

emily_p: please do. i'll sync with design and product tomorrow. quick call: when a view contains pins, should default scope be `route` or `model`?

jen_console: default to `route` but show a clear banner: 'This view locks specific models — switch to latest to maximize compatibility'.

mike_s: noted. i'll add `locked_models: [ids]` + `compatibility_mode` enum (LOCKED|LATEST|SMART) to the schema. SMART will try exact then semver-compatible fallback.

emily_p: great. let's gate behind a canary feature flag for 2 weeks before wide rollout. cc @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: canary flag created: feature.savedview_model_locking, rollout plan: 0% -> 10% next week, monitoring hooks added.

emily_p: thanks — i'll update the rollout checklist and add telemetry queries to the runbook.
